factSheet.title: Example AI Startup Launches Yoruba Voice Assistant in Lagos

claims.text: The company says Example AI, a Lagos-based startup, has launched a Yoruba voice assistant for customer support.
The company says the assistant handled 12000 calls in a pilot.
claims.label: Pilot calls

claims.text: The company says a second pilot handled 4500 calls.
claims.label: Second pilot calls

claims.text: The product docs list Yoruba and Nigerian Pidgin as supported at launch.

flashcards.q: Which languages are supported at launch?
How many calls did the first pilot handle (company-stated)?
